What the risk-connection labels mean

Explicit in source: the source describes the protective purpose; we match it to a risk in the taxonomy.

Weakly inferred — plausible connection: we propose a possible pathway from the action to the risk; the source does not directly establish that connection. Open it to see the assumptions.

Earlier analysis: an existing mapping whose explicit or inferred basis has not yet been reviewed. It is not automatically source-stated.

These labels describe where the reasoning comes from, not evidence that a mitigation is effective.

Choose an action to compare recommendations and read the source passages.
